video_title: Giannis-Jaylen Brown trade ⁉️ Will the Celtics & Bucks make a deal? | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Mike Greenberg
quotes.summary_phrase: Could a Giannis-Jaylen Brown trade make the Celtics East favorites?
quotes.excerpt: Do they become ahead of the Knicks as the favorites in the East?

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: If the Celtics get Giannis, and we don't know exactly what beyond Jaylen Brown they would have to give up, but in a world in which they basically made a trade in which Jaylen Brown went out the door and Giannis came in the door, do they become ahead of the Knicks as the favorites in the East?

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Williams
text_blocks.text: I think it's pretty close. I'll give them a fair shot to beat the Knicks. I think the Knicks have more continuity. It's hard for me to answer that because it's just not Giannis and Jayson Tatum, it's about the ancillary pieces that you have around them that makes the Celtics the way Joe Mazzulla wants to play.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers visiting late lottery prospects suggests potential trade-down strategy
quotes.excerpt: The Los Angeles Clippers started going to visit prospects that were in the late lottery.
quotes.quote: I started talking to agents and I started talking to executives. The Los Angeles Clippers started going to visit prospects that were in the late lottery. Guys who could go from like picks 10 to 15. They have the fifth pick. Why are they doing that? Why are they puzzling? This is a very puzzling thing that they're doing. They could be trading down, yes, but nobody wants this draft is great. The fifth pick is very valuable.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' draft strategy and Kawhi Leonard's uncertain future
quotes.excerpt: We don't really have a good feel for the future of Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.quote: We don't really have a good feel for the future of Kawhi Leonard. Number one, they got this investigation going on. Number two, we got the Clippers making multiple deals at the deadline to go younger. Number three, we potentially have a draft there with the Clippers can pivot. They've already gotten younger. I'm keeping an eye on the Clippers, but I'm also keeping an eye on what happens in Miami and Boston who doesn't get Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay Williams' mock draft pick for the Clippers at five
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with Mikel Brown Jr. I think his upside is tremendous.
quotes.quote: With the fifth pick, if I'm the fifth pick, and if I think if I'm the Clippers, there's a lot of talk around the Clippers, I'm going to go with Mikel Brown Jr. I think his upside is tremendous. I watched the game personally, him against NC State. He had 45 plus points in that game and just controlled every aspect of it. The size, the frame, the passing ability. A lot of people like Keaton Wallace, I love Keaton Wallace too. I think the upside is higher with Mikel Brown Jr.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson's potential as a Chicago Bulls draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I think the biggest upside out of anybody in this draft is Caleb Wilson.
quotes.quote: I think the biggest upside out of anybody in this draft is Caleb Wilson from North Carolina. I think he will be a great pick for the Chicago Bulls with their new head coach Thiago Splitter there. Look, I've seen him play, he's just not a post player. He can do things on the perimeter. They get a chance to do it a lot with the way Hubert Davis likes to play with the two bigs, but I think the way he puts the ball on the ground, his shooting ability, he's a very unique player in this draft.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's consistency makes him a top draft prospect
quotes.excerpt: The upside for this player is 25 and 10 every single night.
quotes.quote: A lot of people get focused on what's the upside, what's the upside. The upside for this player is 25 and 10 every single night and that is three, Cameron Boozer to the Memphis Grizzlies. I love his consistency. Consistency is very underrated. Somebody, he may not play above the rim, he can carp, but think about him, a big that plays like Jalen Brunson to a degree because he plays with angles and he can cut through and he's an elite passer.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's fit with the Utah Jazz backcourt
quotes.excerpt: I think him and Keyonte George together in the backcourt gives them the style in which they like.
quotes.quote: I know they've been waiting all day long for AJ Dybantsa, but that's going to be Darryn Peterson. Look, I think him and Keyonte George together in the backcourt gives them the style in which they like to play, Jaren Jackson and company. His upside is tremendous. People are going to question his ability to be available, but I think anything you saw about him in college, he was unique, even in high school, even more unique.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa's consistency as the top pick in the draft
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with the guy who just has the consistency at the highest level, AJ Dybantsa.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go with the guy who just has the consistency at the highest level, AJ Dybantsa. I think he's an absolute stud. I think he right out of the gate, what do you want to call him, Tracey McGrady, Jaylen Brown, those types of players, that's the kind of dog you bring.

quotes.speaker: Seth Greenberg
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson is the best basketball player athlete in the draft
quotes.excerpt: The best basketball player athlete in this draft, basketball player athlete is that guy, Darryn Peterson.

text_blocks.speaker: Seth Greenberg
text_blocks.text: To me, without a doubt, the best basketball player athlete in this draft, basketball player athlete is that guy, and that's Darryn Peterson. 6'5, 6'10 wingspan, three-level scorer, can defend. And I understand the history of this past year. He got bad advice in a lot of ways. He played on a team that didn't have great spacing, all those things. But that dude right there is a bucket.

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Williams
text_blocks.text: He is a point guard though. If you watch him in high school, the ball was in his hands. When you watch him at Kansas, when he plays off the ball, he can do it, but taking the ball out of his hands limits his versatility and his creativeness in throughout the course of the game.

quotes.speaker: Seth Greenberg
quotes.summary_phrase: Seth Greenberg's advice to Darryn Peterson: just play basketball
quotes.excerpt: Shut up. Absolutely just shut up. I'm a point guard. Look, you're a basketball player.
quotes.quote: Shut up. Absolutely just shut up. I'm a point guard. Look, you're a basketball player. Just go and make plays. Play start, play make, defend, do what you do. But to me, that guy is the best player in the draft.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's versatility is limited by playing off the ball
quotes.excerpt: Taking the ball off his hands limits his versatility and his creativeness in throughout the course of the game.
quotes.quote: If you watch him in high school, the ball was in his hands. When you watch him at Kansas, when he plays off the ball, he can do it, but taking the ball off his hands limits his versatility and his creativeness in throughout the course of the game. So I, if I'm thinking about the Washington Wizards, I'm like you got Trae Young, you got Darryn Peterson. He is going to want the ball in his hands.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa's consistency makes him a top draft priority
quotes.excerpt: I trust in the consistency of who I've seen him to be over the last two years.
quotes.quote: He's going to go one of these guys are going to go number one, number two. No GM is going to skip over Darryn Peterson because they can lose their job if they skip over that pick and then he blows up. But I trust in the consistency of who I've seen him to be over the last two years. He's going through a lot. Doesn't mean that he can't have higher upside, I just trust in AJ Dybantsa.
